name: cluster_name
description: Sets the name of the PostgreSQL cluster, displayed in process titles and used as the default application_name for standby connections.
symptoms: Ambiguous process identification in ps/top output
Confusing log entries across multiple co-located clusters
Difficulty correlating standby connections to their source cluster
tuning_tips: Set to a short, descriptive ASCII string (e.g., 'prod-us-east', 'staging-replica') that uniquely identifies the cluster; avoid spaces or special characters.
